description: Include all Main Missions as checks.
Also called 'The Journey'.
Includes all Journals as checks.
Include all Sub Missions as checks.
Include all Research in the Pal Research Laboratory as checks.
Capture every pal 12 times for the capture bonus is a check.
Includes all Predator Pals as locations.
Includes all of the Raid Pals as Palpedia locations.
Includes all Diamond Passives as locations.
Requires a lot of luck early to obtain them.
Adds all of the Vanity Schematics into the item pool.
Vanity schematics are mostly the hats and caps that gives no armor but can be used to customize your character
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Rank 4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as progression items.
Adds all Furniture Schematics into the item pool.
Furniture Schematics includes all the various building options you can obtain from hunting down the Enemy Bases
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Rank 4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as progression items.
Adds all the Weapon Schematics into the item pool.
This includes all the various weapon schematics you can find from Chests, Dungeons and dropped from Pals. This also includes the weapon schematics that can be bought from shops.
For the ULTRAKILL Collab Schematics to be added, you require both the Weapon and Armour Schematics to be enabled for it to exist.
Fishing Rod Schematics are included as Weapon Schematics
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Rank 4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as progression items.
Adds all the Armour Schematics into the item pool.
This includes all the various armour schematics you can find from Chests, Dungeons and dropped from Pals. This also includes the armour schematics that can be bought from shops.
For the ULTRAKILL Collab Schematics to be added, you require both the Weapon and Armour Schematics to be enabled for it to exist.
Rank 1-2 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as filler items.
Rank 3 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as useful items.
Rank 4 of a Schematic Tier will be treated as progression items.
Adds all skill fruits into the item pool.
Uncommon Skill Fruits are considered as filler items.
Rare Skill Fruits are considered as useful items.
Epic Skill Fruits are considered as progression items.
Adds all of the Remedies and Elixirs into the item pool. Those potions which increases a player's stat.
Remedies and Elixirs are treated as Filler items.
Adds various miscellenous consumables into the pool. Such as medicine and technology point books.
All of these items are considered fillers.
Adds one of each Pal Fruit into the item pool.
Fruits which increases a Pal's hidden stat values.
Starfruits which increases the potential of Pals.
Kinship fruits which increases the trust of Pals
Pal Fruits are treated as Useful items.
Adds one of each Pal Soul into the item pool.
Pal Souls are treated as Useful items.
Adds all of the Work Suitability Technique Books into the item pool.
Useful for those who are capable of generating items into the game on their own.
Technique Books are treated as progression items.
Adds all of the various Implants into the item pool.
When obtained through the multiworld, allow yourself to use said Implant with the Pal Surgery Table or purchase the needed one from the Bounty/Arena Merchant.
Implants are treated as Useful items.
Adds all of the various Passives into the item pool as items.
This is not the same as the implants which already exists in the game.
When obtained through the multiworld, allow yourself to use said Passive on Pals you capture or Breed.
Diamond Passives are treated as progression items.
Golden and White Passives are treated as Useful items.
Red Passives are treated as Filler items.
Includes a 'Player Level' item in the pool which restricts your player level.
Only allow yourself to level up if you obtain the player level item.
You'll get one Player Level item for free at start, as you start off as level 1.
If enabled, will add a level requirement to dungeons, regions and bosses besides their normal requirement.
If you wish to start with the palbox or not.
This will give you one of the spawn locations as your starting location.
If disabled, will always give you 'Windswept Pass' which will allow you to start in Windswept Hills as usual.
To enable spawn locations in the game, make sure your world is set on Multiplayer, click respawn and then you'll be able to pick where to spawn!
Journey: Complete all Main Missions.
Requires 'Journey Missions' to be enabled or it won't generate properly.
Tower Rush: Defeat all 7 Tower Bosses. In any order you want.
If 'All of the Above goal' is activated, this requires you to defeat the hard mode bosses instead. As such the logic will be different.
Legendary Hunt: Defeat or Capture all Legendary Pals
Those being: Necromus, Paladius, Frostallion, Frostallion Noct, Jetragon and Neptilius.
Predator Hunter: Defeat all the different Predator Pals.
Requires 'Predator Pals' to be enabled or this goal will not generate.
Raid Boss: Defeat all the Raid Bosses.
Those being: Blazamut Ryu, Bellanoir, Bellanoir Libero, Xenolord and Hartalis.
Veteran Hunter: Defeat all 100 Overworld Bosses!
Overworld bosses are all the Bosses you can find in the Overworld with a mugshot. Those being Bounties and Alpha Pals.
Master Chef: Cook all the various dishes within Palworld to goal!
Requires 'Chefsanity' enabled or this goal won't appear.
Sub Missions: Require you to complete all the sub missions in the game to goal.
Requires 'Sub Missions checks' enabled or this goal won't appear.
Pal Researcher: Require you to complete all of the Pal Labor Research Laboratory Tasks to goal.
Requires 'Research Task checks' enabled or this goal won't appear.
Catch Them All: Require you to obtain all of the Pals available in the Palpedia to goal.
Journalist: Requires you to read all the Journals spread out throughout Palpagos Isles to goal.
This goal will not generate if 'Journals' are not enabled.
Palpagos Traveler: Require you to travel to all the Travel Points within Palpagos Isles to goal.
Dungeon Dweller: Require you to enter all of the Dungeons to goal.
Requires Dungeons as checks or it won't generate.
Feeling Lucky: Require you to find and capture a Lucky Pal in each Major Region to goal!

The Major Regions are as following; Windswept Hills, Sea-Breeze Archipelago, Bamboo Groves, Crescent Moon Shore, Verdant Brook, Astral Mountains(Not the Foot), Mount Obsidian, Desiccated Dunes, Sakurajima and Feybreak.
Requires 'Lucky Pals' locations to be enabled or the goal won't generate.
Base Builder: Require you to max out your base in order to goal!
All of the Above: Any goals picked above will be required to goal in this all inclusive goal option!
If this option is not enabled, you just require any of the above enabled goals to be completed to win.
Enables all of the merchants which sells pals as checks.
Wears a blue coat.
Enables all of the merchants which sells common items as checks.
Wears a red coat.
Enables all of the merchants which sells ammo as checks.
Wears a green coat.
Enables the arena merchant which sells items for tickets as checks.
Enables all of the bounty merchants which sells items for bounty tokens as checks.
Enables the Medal Merchant which sells items for Dog Coins as checks.
Enables all of the Black Marketeers scattered around the world as checks.
This will add a 'Secret Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Black Marketeers.
This will add a 'Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Wandering Merchants. Both Green and Red.
This will add a 'Pal Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Pal Merchants.
This will add a 'Strange Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Medal Merchants.
This will add a 'Bounty Hunter Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Bounty Hunter Shops.
This will add a 'Arena Membership Card' item into the pool which will then be required to shop from the Arena Merchant.
This will add recipes for all dishes you can cook into the item pool which will then be required to cook said recipe.
They'll be treated as progression items.
This will add orbs of each Element into the pool, restricting the capture of pals if you do not have enough of said element.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The orbs will match the rarity number each pal has, excluding those with a rarity of 20, they'll require 11 orbs instead.
Dual-element Pals requires both of its elements to have enough orbs for them to be in logic.
This will add all the various ingredients into the item pool. Such as Eggs, Milk and Tomatoes.
They'll be treated as filler items.
This will add one of each type of seeds item pool. Such as Tomato Seeds, Potato Seeds and Tomato Seeds.
These seeds will not be considered for logic
They'll be treated as filler items.
This will add all the various food dishes into the item pool. Such as Baked Berries, Bread and Omelette.
They'll be treated as filler items.
Includes all dishes you can cook as checks.
Work really well with the 'Cooking Recipes' option!
When this is enabled, Pals found in Cages will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals found as Dungeon Bosses will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals found during random incidents will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from wild Pal Eggs will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Fishing Pond will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Pal Merchant will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, Pals obtained from the Black Marketeer will be considered for logic.
When this is enabled, you'll require a dungeon's specific key to access it.
Only exception is that the Sealed Realm of Terraria has a dungeon key of its own.
When this is enabled, you'll require the Seal of the Sealed Realm to access said Sealed Realm encounter.
Only exception is that the Sealed Realm of Terraria is considered a Dungeon and not a Sealed Realm for logic reasons.
This will add all the Misc Accessories into the item pool. Such as Pendants, Rings, Whistles, Flutes, Undershirts and the Growth Acceleration Bell.
Their base Tiers will be treated as filler items.
Their mid Tiers will be treated as useful items.
Their highest tier will be treated as progression items.
This will add vouchers of each Element into the pool, restricting the hatching of pals if you do not have the voucher of said element and size.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The vouchers are Progressive, going from Normal > Large > Huge.
Includes all of the dungeons as checks.
When this is enabled, Lovander will be in logic for obtaining cakes for Breeding and Sub-Missions.
Includes finding a Lucky Pal in each Major Region as checks.

The Major Regions are as following; Windswept Hills, Sea-Breeze Archipelago, Bamboo Groves, Crescent Moon Shore, Verdant Brook, Astral Mountains(Not the Foot), Mount Obsidian, Desiccated Dunes, Sakurajima and Feybreak.
When this is enabled, Pals that only have one parent pair while breeding will be considered for logic.
Includes discovering various locations as checks.
This will add an item for each Pal into the pool, restricting the capturing of said Pal until you receive it.
They'll be treated as progression items.
The items are called 'Lamball's Bond', 'Cattiva's Bond' and so forth.
This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
